scope: catalogue-conditioned local sensitivity under declared independent diagonal noise and free calibration scenarios
config_identity: inline fixed scenarios, scales and fiducial in scripts/cf4_information_diagnostic.py

source.table3_role: method PRESENCE only; no second likelihood

fiducial.dA: exp((DMzp-25)/a)/(1+z_true)^2; fixed linearization, not fitted distance

noise_contract: e_DMzp as published marginal sigma; independent per-group mu/redshift/source-motion scenario penalties; not measured full covariance
source_motion_row: pseudo residual c*z-h; model noise penalty, not extra observation
scale_null_contract: isotropic fiducial specialization: delta H=H*epsilon, delta ln dA=-epsilon, delta kappa=a*epsilon; generally all nine expansion coefficients scale together; zero fiducial anisotropy makes their absolute tangent zero
nuisance_contract: one free common mu zero point; optional independent unconstrained offsets for boolean method PRESENCE, not fractional method weights
deletion_contract: remove groups possessing method; retained DMzp never recomputed; depth masks fixed at baseline fiducial

basis.covariance_transform: V_F=T V_C T.T; inverse T for reverse transform

reused_geometry.comparison: legacy per-sample normalized uniform dL spectra are distinct from current fixed physical column scaling

caveats: no actual shared calibration covariance supplied
no physical response fit or significance
first-order latent profiling only; broad distance errors limit approximation
numerical rank is tolerance and scale dependent
method deletion is a footprint diagnostic, not independent distance reanalysis
no global tilt/vorticity or native Bianchi family identification
